_comment: add-flyable-helicopter. Arcade flight for the stolen police helicopter: metres, seconds, m/s and m/s². The left stick asks for a horizontal velocity in the helicopter's heading frame (up to max_speed_mps); with the stick let go it brakes at brake_mps2 and levels out, so it holds where it is. Triggers ask for a climb or descent rate; with neither it holds its height. Bumpers turn it. ceiling_m is height above the ground below; past it the climb stops and it is pushed back down. The soft boundary pushes it back inside the map at boundary_push_mps per metre past boundary_margin_m from the edge. crash_*: contact faster than crash_min_mps is a hard hit; what that does comes from the mode's outcomes.aircraft. Holding reset (R3 / R) lifts it to lift_clear_m above the highest surface found within lift_probe_m above it (a roof it is stuck in), to unstick it.
